text: Lu et al. 2020 report OSK (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4) reprogramming experiments addressing retinal ganglion cell axon regeneration and visual function in injury, glaucoma and aging settings.

Lu et al. report that TET1 and TET2 activity is required for beneficial OSK-associated axon regeneration and visual improvement. This is evidence of demethylation involvement, not a directly observed Read(H) storage mechanism.
Mouse RRBS DNA methylation and RNA sequencing reads are deposited under BioProject PRJNA655981. Data are bulk/sorted-cell population measurements unless explicitly indicated otherwise.
GSE147436 is a HUMAN differentiated neuron DNA methylation EPIC-array experiment, not a mouse RGC sample series. Never merge as mouse methylation without species annotation.
The Nature paper offers Supplementary Data DNAm.csv for methylation ageing signature analysis. The raw 403 MB supplementary file has not been downloaded into this package.
Lu et al. report restoration of a substantial fraction of age-associated gene expression differences after OSK treatment in purified RGCs. This does not establish a single-cell longitudinal lineage.
